progress.label: First-playable game foundation
progress.basis: Tracked gates: Evolved mechanics; party modes; reusable adventures; live dinosaur peril; source-driven NPC travel. Remaining: offensive combat, procedural adventures, graphical playtest sign-off.
progress.note: This measures the specified first-playable foundation, not unlimited future campaigns.

roadmap.label: Complete approved Dinosaur Horror RPG development roadmap
roadmap.scope: 18 bounded acceptance gates across Evolved parity, party and character options, scenario-independent systems, encounters, authored and generated adventures, Game Mother, wonder and horror, persistence, trust and QA. A finished delivery target—not the impossible exhaustion of endlessly generated stories.
roadmap.note: Accepted whole-product weight remains 38/100. 009-D1 adds an independently playable original estuary adventure and removes Long Count singleton map/stock/save/view assumptions from the standalone runtime; scenario independence and authored variety are still partial. NPC action economy, offensive combat, procedural Cinematic/Campaign and graphical QA remain open.

gates.label: Evolved dice, stress, injury and core resolution baseline
gates.acceptance: Existing certified deterministic dice, pushed checks, stress, opposed checks, injury foundations and documented reference boundaries; does not certify every optional Evolved rule.

gates.label: Party, Focus and Spectator control modes
gates.acceptance: Switchable one-survivor, whole-party and spectator ownership; deterministic turns, manual step/pause, and save validation.

gates.label: Versioned compiled adventure packages and seeded variants
gates.acceptance: Validated authoring schema, seeded alternate facts, stable fingerprints and preserved historical adventure bindings; universal runtime parity tracked separately.

gates.label: Persistent local wildlife and Evolved defensive encounters
gates.acceptance: Physically grounded animal placement, predator contact, defensive reactions, combat time and injuries in the accepted research implementation; not full offensive parity.

gates.label: Cinematic briefing, agendas, handouts and Story Cards
gates.acceptance: Versioned, source-gated original dossier material; no source-unearned Story Point rewards or secure client-held secrets implied.

gates.label: Physically placed supporting cast, dialogue and return-route autonomy
gates.acceptance: Local conversations, source-authorized objective-triggered connected movement, save replay evidence and historical rev10 preservation; not independent tactical NPC intelligence.

gates.label: Complete adopted Evolved Edition mechanics and advancement
gates.acceptance: Audit and integrate applicable talent effects, story point awards/spending, panic consequences, modifiers, helping, combat/medical conditions, advancement and source-defined exceptions in both adventures; invisible rolls remain reproducible.

gates.label: Equipment-limited offensive survivor combat and creature consequences
gates.acceptance: Real carried weapons, ammo and equipment state; Evolved initiative/actions, attack rolls, armor, damage, injuries and appropriate dinosaur reactions/retreat across both adventure packages with regression cases.

gates.label: Perception-bound independent human NPC choices and consequences
gates.acceptance: Characters respond to real local perception, evidence and motives; choose grounded reactions, social behavior, resource actions, Evolved turns, injury and self-preservation without omniscience or forced combat.

gates.label: Fully adventure-independent party/runtime and durable saves
gates.acceptance: Remove remaining hardcoded Nublar game assumptions from shared rules, adjudication and UI; same physical actions/rules/saves across independently defined settings and original adventures; preserve accepted old saves.

gates.label: Complete manual, generated and hybrid characters and progression
gates.acceptance: Any/all characters individually manual, automatic or hybrid with unlocked-field reroll, legal careers/attributes/skills/talents/equipment, relationships/backgrounds, preview/edit/import and Evolved-governed experience/career growth usable in gameplay.

gates.label: Full grounded natural-language Game Mother and adjudication
gates.acceptance: Understand open-ended player actions, select warranted rules/stakes, portray distinct people, make bounded creative proposals and exceptions, narrate only committed outcomes and discovered secrets, and honor all control modes and safe engine authority.

gates.label: Varied original pregenerated adventures and meaningful replays
gates.acceptance: Several distinct authored adventures with different premises, physical situations and goals; repeated seed runs alter causal secrets/NPCs/animals/scenes/outcomes materially, not only cosmetic names; quiet completions remain possible.

gates.label: Validated original procedural Cinematic adventure generation
gates.acceptance: Generate and validate coherent new maps, objectives, cast, agendas, clues, scenes, animal behavior, tension shifts and endings; no required three-act sequence or guaranteed carnivore attack, all using the same game engine.

gates.label: Persistent procedurally generated continuing campaigns
gates.acceptance: Persist relationships, wounds, inventory, discovered facts and world consequences across episodes; generate causally connected new dilemmas and varied wonder/action/dread cycles without resets or stale fact contradictions.

gates.label: Testable suspense, action and sense-of-wonder design
gates.acceptance: Multiple optional calm discoveries and beautiful animal scenes, independent herbivore/predator temperaments, justified environmental escalations, quiet exits, recoveries and meaningful choice in authored and generated scenarios, regression-reviewed for tone and agency.

gates.label: Desktop/mobile UX, accessibility and release smoke
gates.acceptance: Real graphical desktop and mobile testing of both seeds/scenarios, all three control modes, character builder, save/load/recovery, NPC movement and combat; verify keyboard/touch use and accessible narrative output before sign-off.

gates.label: Server-private secrets, safe saves and secure AI access
gates.acceptance: Keep unrevealed scenario facts and GM plans unavailable in client source, secure Worker credentials/rate limits, validate trusted state transitions/save migration and fail safely on absent/malformed model responses.
